$note: When an invoice record is created, generate a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X hybrid PDF and save it to Directus Files. Mirrors the n8n einvoice-webhook-to-pdf template. Assumes an 'invoices' collection whose records carry the invoice payload; the operation reads it from the trigger via {{ $trigger.payload.invoice }}. PolyDoc generates the compliant document; transmission (Peppol), archiving and reporting are separate. Add your key as the POLYDOC_API_KEY env var (or set the operation's API Key).

flow.name: PolyDoc - Record to e-invoice
flow.description: Turn a new invoice record into a compliant EU e-invoice PDF.
